$comment: Structural budgets for the feed row-cost harness (issue #1103). Exact counts, not timings: they are deterministic, so they can gate CI. Lower a ceiling when an optimization lands; raising one is a decision to write down in the PR. Bloom 7.31 + react-native-css 3.1.0-rc.0 (inline video on iPhone Safari): text hostNodes 52.125 -> 53.125 because Bloom 7.9.2 gives the avatar placeholder image its own positioned wrapper so it paints above the absolute shape fill on web; linkPreview contextReads 53 -> 55 because react-native-css 3.1.0-rc.0 re-runs an interop component's rule effect after commit (its StrictMode-safe subscription), so the link card's interop Pressable reads its two CSS contexts twice on mount.
